scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version"
scripts.push: git push origin master && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run tag && npm run push
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run tag && npm run push
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && npm run tag && npm run push
